Oversight / Professional Agency: California Division of Occupational Safety and Health

Purpose: Ensures the competence of personnel caring for, inspecting and maintaining power presses equipped for PSDI operation

(confidence Medium) | [AUTO] Not enumerated: the General Industry Safety Orders container is cross_cutting, but this hazard has no plausible occurrence in a HealthStream care setting, so the obligation is emitted once, anchored on role rather than on a setting it does not reach. General competence clause with no enumerated topics, hours, curriculum, demonstration, or approval requirement. | Self-refutation check: the third-party validation organization in 4208.1 certifies/validates the PSDI safety system and approves brake-monitor adjustments - equipment certification, not approval of the training. Oversight / Professional Agency: California Division of Occupational Safety and Health

(confidence High) | [AUTO] Not enumerated: the General Industry Safety Orders container is cross_cutting, but this hazard has no plausible occurrence in a HealthStream care setting, so the obligation is emitted once, anchored on role rather than on a setting it does not reach. Regulatory Change Summary: The operator training required by Section 4203 must be provided before the employee initially operates a PSDI-mode press and as needed to maintain competence, but not less than annually, and 4208.1(m) adds the PSDI-specific content and a certification record.
Interpretive Summary: Supports an annually recurring operator assignment whose base content comes from Section 4203 with a PSDI-specific increment and a certification artifact.
Source Change Context: The operator training required by section 4203 shall be provided to the employee before the employee initially operates the press and as needed to maintain competence, but not less than annually thereafter
